=================================================================
  PURE NAND 4-BIT RAM & ALU COMPUTER ARCHITECTURE
=================================================================
Built strictly from first principles starting from single NAND gates:
- Level 1: Basic Logic (NOT, AND, OR, NOR, XOR, XNOR)
- Level 2: Arithmetic Adders (Half Adder, Full Adder, 4-Bit Adder)
- Level 3: Multiplexers & Decoders (2:1 MUX, 4:1 MUX, 4-Bit Bus MUX, 2-to-4 Decoder)
- Level 4: Latches & BitCells (4-NAND D-Latch, Gated BitCell)
- Level 5: Registers (4-Bit Word Register)
- Level 6: Addressable RAM (4 words x 4-bit = 16-bit RAM with CS & WE)
- Level 7: Integrated System (4-Bit RAM + ALU Accumulator Unit)

Tip: Select any subchip and click 'Look Inside' to drill down through all 7 layers down to raw NAND!

=== MODULE 1: 4-WORD x 4-BIT RAM (Level 6) ===
How to Operate:
1. Select Address using Addr0, Addr1 switches (00=Word0, 01=Word1, 10=Word2, 11=Word3).
2. Turn CS (Chip Select) ON.
3. WRITE: Set Data In [D0..D3], then click WE (Write Enable) ON then OFF.
4. READ: Keep WE OFF and CS ON. The LEDs [Q0..Q3] immediately display the stored 4-bit word!

=== MODULE 2: 4-BIT RIPPLE CARRY ADDER (Level 2) ===
Calculates: [A3..A0] + [B3..B0] + Cin = [Cout, S3..S0]
Built from Full Adders -> Half Adders -> XOR & AND -> Pure NANDs!

=== MODULE 3: INTEGRATED 4-BIT RAM + ALU ACCUMULATOR SYSTEM (Level 7) ===
Combines the 4x4 RAM and the 4-bit ALU into an integrated CPU data-path:
Reads the selected word from RAM and adds it to the incoming Operand + Cin in real-time!
- RAM Out [Q0..Q3]: Displays stored word at selected address.
- ALU Result [Sum0..Sum3, Cout]: Displays (RAM_Word + Operand + Cin).
